scope: First-party Statcast design and class-eligible attribute research on twelve champions. These are original, untested comparison plans; only Green Goblin's Battlecast name is explicitly recommended by Kabam.

sources.title: Kabam developer diary: Statcast Relics, attributes and champion scaling examples
Kabam update: Statcasts work on defense, Battlecasts do not
Kabam balance update: attacker and defender Stat Focus mechanics
Kabam champion spotlight: Green Goblin (Stellar Forged) focus and Hulk Battlecast

relicResearch.statcastReason: Low base Critical Rating makes a same-rank, same-matchup Statcast Critical Rating trial meaningful, but a direct-hit improvement must be distinguished from Shock and Power Burn damage.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: The Hulkbuster Battlecast is worth comparing only with its actual selected rune and an attack sequence that can satisfy the trigger; a Striker alone is not evidence of extra power control.
relicResearch.comparison: Compare equal Armor Up and Shock setups against one defender; record SP1 into block control, SP2 damage and health lost using each relic at the same rank.
relicResearch.limitations: Crit bonuses cannot create Armor Ups or bypass a defender's Power Burn immunity; the named Statcast variant and the Battlecast rune are unverified.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Kabam identifies Kingpin's relatively low base Critical Rating as a possible stat-boost opportunity. Evaluate eligible direct hits during equal Rage and Overpower conditions.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: A Battlecast could still be superior if its verified runes enhance the specific Degeneration, Rage or utility sequence, rather than just offering another striker hit.
relicResearch.comparison: Against a fixed unarmored practice defender, compare matched Rage stacks, SP1 output and block damage taken across three clean fights before investing.
relicResearch.limitations: Do not promise more Rage or stronger Degeneration ticks from Critical Rating; actual Statcast primary and secondary attributes must be inspected in game.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Guardian converts natural critical opportunities into Shock-related damage. Kabam specifically points to Critical Damage Rating as a scaling stat, which should be compared at fixed Force Field resources.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: A Hulkbuster-style Battlecast may add utility only if its current rune effects actually work with Guardian's Armor and Shock interactions; do not inherit the third-party shortlist.
relicResearch.comparison: Measure the same SP2 sequence at identical Force Field charge counts with the actual owned Statcast attributes and a separately verified Battlecast rune setup.
relicResearch.limitations: Critical Damage Rating is not a guarantee of critical-hit frequency or Shock application; never assume one statue name fixes the secondary stat.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Shuri's Critical Shocks are an explicit example in Kabam's Statcast design notes. Compare Critical Damage Rating while holding Matrix Charges and the Shock refresh timing constant.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: A Battlecast option needs its rune triggers independently confirmed on Shuri; do not import relic pairings from the withheld compiled source catalog.
relicResearch.comparison: Test the same number of Critical Shock conversions on the same defender and record direct-hit versus damage-over-time changes separately.
relicResearch.limitations: Enemy Shock immunity and Miss counters can invalidate the trial; an attribute-only hypothesis does not verify any exact Statcast variant.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Kabam identifies Armor Rating as scaling Lady Deathstrike's damage. Test the attribute with the same Armor state, Rupture count and Ferocity window.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: Any Battlecast must be evaluated for a concrete rune trigger and a safe Striker cancel, not simply because it shares the champion's Tech class.
relicResearch.comparison: Compare matching basic-hit sequences with and without the owned Armor Rating relic; log Rupture damage and block health loss independently.
relicResearch.limitations: An Armor Rating increase is not another Armor Up buff. Losing her Armor state or facing Rupture immunity invalidates the straightforward comparison.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Jack O'Lantern uses a Heavy-cancel into SP1 with Precision and Inflamed; Kabam lists him among champions with damage scaling from Critical Damage Rating.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: Evaluate any Battlecast only if its official or in-game rune can trigger safely during the Heavy cancel or Inflamed phase; the existing shortlist is unapproved.
relicResearch.comparison: Match the same Inflamed count and the SP1 cancel timing, then compare damage before and after the actual Statcast's primary and secondary attributes.
relicResearch.limitations: Do not infer that Critical Damage Rating raises critical chance or the duration of Inflamed; the exact secondary variant remains unchecked.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Mister Negative builds Light Energy through well-timed blocks and uses a charged Heavy to convert that resource. Kabam suggests additional Block Proficiency for survivability.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: A Battlecast candidate is not a substitute for a documented safe Heavy counter-Evade opening; verify whether its rune activates during the planned conversion first.
relicResearch.comparison: Against one controlled basic-combo defender, compare block damage over ten eligible block events while holding the Light Energy and Dark Energy sequence constant.
relicResearch.limitations: Block Proficiency changes blocking survival, not the number of guaranteed Dark Energy charges; anti-Evade opponents may invalidate the attack route.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Tigra's Sense maintenance and careful non-contact Special punishes reward surviving occasional unavoidable blocks. Kabam identifies Block Proficiency as a useful Statcast trial.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: A Battlecast should be judged on whether an equipped rune assists Neutralize or the safe Heavy punish; a striker animation is not itself proof of synergy.
relicResearch.comparison: Hold Senses, opponent and Special punish sequence equal, then measure chip damage from blocking and Rupture uptime with the owned Statcast versus a verified Battlecast.
relicResearch.limitations: Blocking stats do not turn unsafe contact hits into a Tigra Miss or bypass Neutralize resistance; relic secondary attributes remain unconfirmed.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Kabam proposes Block Proficiency as a survivability lever for Deathless Guillotine. Test it while holding Soul charges and the SP2 healing-reversal choice equal.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: The competing Battlecast should be considered only after its rune applicability is checked for this specific Soul-spending and critical-hit Degeneration kit.
relicResearch.comparison: Use the same long-fight opponent to compare total blocked damage, Soul count after the test and SP2 healing-reversal uptime, controlling relic rank.
relicResearch.limitations: More Block Proficiency does not create Souls or guarantee a heal-reversal trigger; no exact Statcast primary-secondary statue has been selected.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Kabam's champion spotlight favors sustain-oriented offensive Stat Focus such as Adrenaline or Armor Rating. For Statcasts, test Armor Rating primarily for comparable survival, not as a unique-debuff generator.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: Kabam explicitly recommends the Hulk Battlecast for this champion because its Physical Vulnerability can contribute another distinct debuff during a tank-style damage sequence.
relicResearch.comparison: Compare Hulk Battlecast with any class-compatible Armor Rating Statcast over the same SP1-to-SP2 debuff cycle, matching opponent armor and completed debuff types.
relicResearch.limitations: The Battlecast endorsement is a publisher suggestion, not tested best-in-slot performance. Check the actual rune, relic rarity and owned Statcast secondary.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Kabam identifies Adrenaline or Armor Rating as alternatives for this champion's limited long-fight sustain. Trial Adrenaline for recovery rather than claiming it increases the SP2 Incinerate multiplier; compare Armor Rating against the same encounter, damage taken, and debuff setup.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: Kabam explicitly names Block Penetration as a defender option because this kit pressures blocking opponents with debuffs. It increases outgoing blocked-hit damage, not incoming durability; compare Block Proficiency against an attacker who safely avoids most blocked hits.
statFocusRecommendation.note: Publisher-named options, independently summarized. The choice is a measured-comparison starting point, not a verified best-in-slot relic or Stat Focus result.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Jean Grey's SP2-oriented energy offense offers a test of Special Damage, but changes in Neuroshock stack and Energy Penetration can dominate a raw stat comparison.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: A Battlecast with an applicable Special boost may outperform a Statcast in one fight; verify the rune and never infer its utility from a community name-matching table.
relicResearch.comparison: Use the same Neuroshock and Prowess setup against a single defender to compare SP2 damage, total duration and blocked health loss across repeated fights.
relicResearch.limitations: Special Damage focus and relic stats are not equivalent, and this trial does not establish any exact Jean Grey Statcast secondary variant.

relicResearch.statcastReason: Spider-Woman's Fury buildup and later Power Sting and Shock interactions create separate direct-hit and debuff contributions; trial Critical Rating only on the direct-hit portion.
relicResearch.battlecastReason: Some players report a particular Science Battlecast can change her damage substantially, but this is community experience and needs confirmation of rune and mechanic rather than copied pairing data.
relicResearch.comparison: Record a fixed Fury count, SP1 Shock and Sting ticks, and SP2 direct-hit damage against the same opponent before selecting the owned relic to rank.
relicResearch.limitations: No named Battlecast has been independently approved here; Power Sting triggers and incoming Special behavior vary by defender and node.
